assertEquals("PLAIN auth failed: wrong password", e.getMessage());
```

The test was asserting an exact match of the error message returned by the `SaslException`. This strict comparison could lead to test failures if the actual error message contained additional context or formatting differences, resulting in false negatives.

String message = e.getMessage();

assertContains("wrong password", message);
```

This allows for variations in the error output while still validating that the essential components of the error message are present, thus preventing false negatives in the test results.
